needed.evidence: No footway on the left side of the road, pedestrians must walk in the roadway.
needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous sidewalk along the left side of the road to provide a safe walking space for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: Informal path on the right side is under 1m wide and not usable as a proper footway.
needed.suggestion: Upgrade the informal path on the right side to a proper, continuous sidewalk that is at least 1m wide.

needed.evidence: Uneven sections on the informal path on the right side pose trip hazards.
needed.suggestion: Repair and level the uneven sections of the informal path on the right side to eliminate trip hazards.

needed.evidence: No proper crossing facility is present despite pedestrian demand.
needed.suggestion: Install a signalised pedestrian crossing with a refuge island to ensure safe crossing for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: The marked crossing is poorly visible and does not ensure drivers will stop.
needed.suggestion: Improve the visibility of the marked crossing by adding high-visibility markings and consider adding a refuge island for safety.

needed.evidence: No dropped kerbs at the crossing, making it difficult for pedestrians with disabilities.
needed.suggestion: Install kerb ramps at the crossing to ensure accessibility for all pedestrians, including those with disabilities.
